title: Worker screens: check the last turn is drawn after a pane send
notes: On the --screen trial the real-card screen's log ended at the prompt pane send typed, while the transcript held the full reply and the PR it opened. The small screen worker drew its later replies fine, so this may be the read itself (a long log only draws near the screen). Reproduce with a long conversation and a pane send.

comments.body: From main-dashboard: build the fix at the root, with a test for the decision. Tests must be Windows-safe. Run pnpm test, typecheck and lint. If you can't reproduce it on current code, say so on the card with the evidence and open no PR. Do not bump the version.
Pull request #309 opened: Keep a pinned Claude screen at its end when it is shown again https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/309
